components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { background: #16171a; color: #fff; font: 700 14px/16px Overpass, sans-serif; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #33353b; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #16171a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Location Roundel
components.description: A Location's identity: its line colour and code.
components.css: .ds-roundel { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%; background: #b34a0c; color: #fff; font: 800 10px Overpass, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .02em; }

components.name: Status Signal
components.description: A 16x4 line segment: solid online, dotted offline, dashed not enrolled.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 600 13px Overpass, sans-serif; color: #16171a; } .ds-status i { width: 16px; border-top: 4px solid #1d7a4a; }

components.name: Route Station
components.description: A hop drawn as a station on the run Location's 6px line.
components.css: .ds-station { position: relative; display: inline-block; width: 40px; height: 40px; } .ds-station::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 17px; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 6px; background: #b34a0c; } .ds-station b { position: absolute; left: 13px; top: 13px; width: 14px; height: 14px; box-sizing: border-box; border: 3px solid #16171a; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; }

narrative.overview: Carriers draw their networks as transit diagrams; Looking Glass takes that grammar literally. Each Location is a coloured line with a roundel code, each hop a station, each status a way of drawing the line. Chrome is neutral paper and ink so any operator brand sits on it; colour belongs to network data only.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral map paper / charcoal night map, ink chrome
Location line colours are the only saturated colour
Square panels, hairlines, 2px controls, round roundels and stations
Overpass for reading, Overpass Mono for data
Route view: hops as stations on the run's line

rules.name: The Line Owns the Colour Rule
rules.body: Saturated colour appears only on Location data. Buttons, links, navigation and focus are ink.

rules.name: The light-dark() Rule
rules.body: Every semantic token is one light-dark() value; flip a subtree with .dark / .light.

rules.name: The Mono Means Data Rule
rules.body: Mono only for tool output, addresses, commands, ports, ASNs, tokens.

rules.name: The Flat Map Rule
rules.body: At-rest surfaces never cast a shadow; no glow.

dos: Do lead any Location display with its roundel via data-line + lineStyle(id)
Do use ruled rows inside one panel for collections
Do keep raw tool output intact beside any visualisation
Do keep one primary ink action per view
donts: Don't use neon-on-black, CRT, glow or traffic-light window dots
Don't use gradients, glass or soft rounded card grids
Don't colour chrome with a line or signal colour
Don't add uppercase tracked labels, eyebrows or monospace labels
Don't cast shadows from at-rest surfaces
